lane: Brand documents and communications with local website canonical URL alignment
goal: Use owner-selected magicpendigital.com organization domain and nilaza.magicpendigital.com website in current Nilaza branding and media deliverables, sources and local web URL defaults.
successCriteria: Current guides, slide text/notes, hyperlinks, social/OG exports, source files and preview ZIP contain the official Nilaza hostname and preserve VI/EN paths.
Brand guidelines and manifest record the official organization and product domains so future authoring uses the same source.
All changed exports are rendered, inspected and checksum-validated; existing stale Help snapshots are refreshed from the approved allowlist without adding product behavior.
Historical evidence, archive slides, backend configuration, credentials, existing unrelated edits and all customer data are preserved.
untouchedSurfaces: Mobile and Admin implementation, auth callbacks, API contracts, RLS, storage, credits, analytics and Supabase migrations/configuration remain unchanged.
Historical DNS audit results, prior browser/native evidence and archived slide revisions remain historical records; organization email senders are not inferred from the website hostname.
DNS, Cloudflare, SMTP, CORS/Turnstile settings, official publication and deployment are separate future environment actions.

impact.entryPoint: Current local launch package, guides, social/OG images, localized website and Help links; locale routes remain /vi and /en.
impact.dataWrite: Repository documents, official-domain manifest metadata, generators, source snapshots, current media/Office/PDF exports and review receipts only. No user or database data writes.
impact.backendContract: No endpoint or deployed contract change. Record pending origin/SMTP/redirect configuration separately; keep waitlist and app auth behavior unchanged.
impact.adminVisibility: Both protected Admin workspaces and owner identity examples are unchanged. Internal brand/audit reports stay outside public Help and search corpus.
impact.privacySafety: Only approved public Help content and existing labeled synthetic web captures are used. No user content, secrets, contacts or email transmission.
impact.observability: Local render/checksum evidence proves artifact consistency, not DNS activation, live links or deployment. Existing events and tracking stay unchanged.
impact.rollback: Save scoped before-images under .brand-work/domain-update-20261004; restore only these files and regenerate exports if needed. No destructive resets or customer-data effects.

canonicalContracts: Owner decision on 2026-10-04: organization magicpendigital.com; Nilaza website https://nilaza.magicpendigital.com, VI/EN Help on the same host.
Brand Guidelines and brand-identity.json are the official identity sources; approved Help Markdown is the only public guide content source.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Existing scoped planning, public-boundary, render and hash checks cover this domain correction; no new agent workflow or runtime behavior.

skillReview.name: nilaza-brand-experience
skillReview.evidence: Skill delegates exact identity and domain facts to Brand Guidelines/manifest; existing instructions cover source/export parity and current public Help.

dependencyReview.evidence: No dependency upgrades or external API assumptions. Use existing repository generators, bundled Node/Python packages and existing portable LibreOffice/Poppler rendering tools; domain is supplied by owner.

securityReview.authzRls: No authentication, authorization, RLS, grants or remote access changes; document examples only.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Use approved bilingual public Help and previously labeled test captures; no live user data.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No environment-secret reads or logs, SMTP/API key creation, provider calls or email recipients.
securityReview.externalInput: Owner-selected hostname is editorial input only. Render local repository-controlled HTML; no external instruction or untrusted document execution.
securityReview.dependencies: No new packages. Retain existing approved generator/rendering paths; use workspace-bundled runtimes for Office/PDF authoring.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No database push/repair/deployment/publication. Preserve blocked migration ledger and distinguish local preparation from release.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop affected artifact handoff if current source parity, page layout, Vietnamese glyphs or domain checks fail; repair locally before updating manifest.

workingTreeReview.note: Existing dirty AGENTS and Resend plan work is preserved; apply additive owner-domain decisions and scoped URL changes only. Unrelated dirty mobile/Admin/release work is outside this task.

validationCommands: Render every changed Office/PDF page and review all changed social/OG graphics; inspect old-host scan and ZIP parity.
managerTestPath: Open current launch README/index; view VI/EN guides, last slide and social footers; download ZIP and check all public links use nilaza.magicpendigital.com with retained locale paths.
residualRisk: Official hostname selection does not verify DNS/TLS, live website, CORS, Turnstile or SMTP. Existing app screenshots remain labeled preview, not new native/store acceptance.
